messages.subject: Re: Shiny and D3js+ search engine+ontology browser
parts: Yes, D3 is by no means the only way to create JavaScript visualizations and UI. If you find another JavaScript tree component or whatever that you think would meet your needs, there's a good chance you'd be able to integrate it with Shiny by writing a custom output binding for it. It is not the easiest thing but there are people on this list who can help you through it.
